verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services company with a case-preparation platform, so offering scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no API, no credential issuance and no permission scoping, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
